**Peru: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 612,174 applications. The largest annual volume was 259,834 in 2019; 2025 recorded 18,697. Applications in 2025 were 93% lower than in 2019 (259,834). In 2025, 1,897 recorded decisions equated to 10 per 100 applications, so recorded output fell below incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 43% lower than in 2024 (32,854). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 3 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) (17,400), Colombia (557), Cuba (329).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 3.1%, across 1,792 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 5.5% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 12.4 percentage points lower than in 2024 (15%).
